" http://localhost/ 2>/dev/null || wget -q -O /dev/null --server-response http://localhost/ 2>&1 | head -3'; echo "--- imageID ---"; kubectl get pod "$POD" -o jsonpath='{.status.containerStatuses[0].image}{"
"}{.status.containerStatuses[0].imageID}{"
"}'

call.name: bash
call.arguments: {"command": "sleep 20; kubectl get deploy app; echo \"---\"; kubectl get pods -l app=app --no-headers | awk '{print $1, $2, $3, $4}'; echo \"--- node taint ---\"; kubectl get node -o jsonpath='{range .items[*].spec.taints[*]}{.key}={.value}:{.effect}{\"\\n\"}{end}'; echo \"--- node unschedulable ---\"; kubectl get node -o jsonpath='{.items[0].spec.unschedulable}{\"\\n\"}'"}
